84-Point IC/LC Legal Checklist

₹999 catalogue price for one organisation. The current checklist covers 84 legal checkpoints across eight domains, with eight independent finalisation gates and conditional IC/LC pathways. Licensed online access lasts 120 days from verified purchase.

The current legal checklist helps the competent IC/LC assess jurisdiction, fairness, record-linked evidence, allegation-wise reasoning, representations, authorised outcomes and report handover. The Committee remains responsible for conclusions, approval and secure records.

Compliance Checklist

₹1,999 for one assessment. Review one workplace or branch for one review year and download the completed report.

Spot POSH compliance gaps early

The POSH Compliance Checklist helps you review your workplace practices and prioritise what needs attention. Addressing gaps early matters because certain employer failures under Section 26(1) of the POSH Act can attract a fine of up to ₹50,000.
